subject: general
question:
A hemispherical bowl is of radius 7.7 cm. It is to be painted from inside as well as outside. Find the cost (in ₹) of painting the bowl at a rate of ₹17 per 7 cm².

[{Take } pi = (22)/(7)]
solution:
Given:

A hemispherical bowl has a radius of 7.7 cm. It is to be painted from the inside as well as outside.

The cost of painting it is at the rate of ₹17 per 7 sq. cm.

Concept used:

Curved surface area of a solid hemisphere = 2π(Radius)2

Calculation:

Curved surface area of the bowl = 2π × (7.7)2 = 372.68 cm2

Now, the cost of painting the bowl

⇒ 17 × (372.68 ÷ 7) × 2 (∵ Inside as well as outside is being painted. That's why multiplying by 2)

⇒ ₹1810.16

∴ The cost of painting it at the rate of ₹17 per 7 sq. cm will be ₹**1810.16.**
